Hi there, and thank you for contacting Leafy! I'm happy to help with this.

Unfortunately, because you've already used your free shipping benefit, a refund isn't available. Leafy Plus is only fully refundable if both of these are true:

- You cancel within **14 days** of purchase or renewal. You're at day 10, so this part is fine.
- **No benefits have been used.** Free shipping counts as a benefit, so this part isn't met.

If you cancel, you would still keep all your Leafy Plus benefits until the end of your paid year:

- Free Standard shipping with no minimum
- Free change-of-mind returns
- A 90-day Plant Care Guarantee
- 10% member pricing on pots and accessories
- Early access to rare plant drops

Cancelling would also stop the membership from auto-renewing at $59/year.

If you'd like to ask for an exception, I can pass your request to a Support Lead, though I can't promise the outcome. Just let me know, and I'll tell you what to expect next.

Thanks again for being part of the Leafy family. Please reach out any time if you need anything else! 🌿
